entities.summary: Michel Fontaine was a French radiologist and politician who was a member of the Senate. He was elected in 2011 as one of three senators for the overseas department of Réunion. He was not re-elected in 2017. He was a member of Les Républicains. He was also the mayor of Saint-Pierre, Réunion from 2001 until his death on 27 March 2025, at the age of 72.
